# data prep
```{r}
# load sub list
participant_name = "sub_39.csv"
participants_df = read.csv(file = paste(data_dir, participant_name, sep = "/"), header = TRUE)

posterior_names = c('alpha_i', 'tau_i', 'epsilon_i')
prior_names = c('alpha0', 'tau0', 'epsilon0', 'norm0')

norm0_df = read.csv(file = paste(fits_dir, "sub_include_norm0_guess.csv", sep = "/"), 
                      header = TRUE)
```

# computer 
```{r}
set.seed(123)

cvs_suff = "_alphaRANDtauRANDnorm0informedUPDATED_ugrRL_fminsearch_computer.csv"
fig_folder = "ugRL_fminsearch"
dir.create(file.path(figures_dir, fig_folder))
plot_title = "min(negLL) + 1"

for (i in 1:nrow(participants_df)) {
  # i = 1
  sub_i_name = participants_df$subjID[i]
  sub_i_csv = paste(sub_i_name, cvs_suff, sep = "")
  
  sub_i_fit_all = read.csv(paste(fits_dir, sub_i_csv, sep = "/"), header = T) %>% na.omit()
  sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit_all %>% 
    filter(exitflag == 1) %>% 
    select(c("negLL", prior_names, posterior_names))
  
  min_negLL = min(sub_i_fit$negLL)
  
  thresh_negLL = min_negLL
  # thresh_type = "negLLmin"
  sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[sub_i_fit$negLL == thresh_negLL, ]
  N_plot = nrow(sub_i_fit)
  
  while (N_plot == 1) {
    thresh_negLL = thresh_negLL+0.5
    
    sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[sub_i_fit$negLL == thresh_negLL, ]
    N_plot = nrow(sub_i_fit)
  }
  thresh_type = "negLLmin_flex"
  
  # thresh_negLL = min_negLL+0.5
  # thresh_type = "negLLminPLUS0p5"
  sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[sub_i_fit$negLL <= thresh_negLL, ]
  N_plot = nrow(sub_i_fit)
  # 
  # thresh_negLL = min_negLL+1
  # thresh_type = "negLLminPLUSone"
  # sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[sub_i_fit$negLL <= thresh_negLL, ]
  # N_plot = nrow(sub_i_fit)
  
  # # generate 1000 samples from the remaining rows using bootstrapping
  # random_1000 <- sample(1:nrow(sub_i_fit), size = 1000, replace = TRUE)
  # sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[random_1000,]
  
  print(paste(i, sub_i_name, nrow(sub_i_fit), sep = "/"))
  print(sub_i_csv)
  
  posterior_fminsearch_histo_plot_fun(sub_i_name, sub_i_fit, thresh_type, cvs_suff, fig_folder, w_histo, h_histo, bin_N, figures_dir)
  
  # corrMatrix_plot_fun(sub_i_name, sub_i_fit, plot_title, w_corr, h_corr, figures_dir, fig_folder)
}
```

## min negLL+0.5
```{r}
set.seed(123)

cvs_suff = "_alphaRANDtauRANDnorm0informedUPDATED_ugrRL_fminsearch_computer.csv"
fig_folder = "ugRL_fminsearch_negLLminPLUS"
dir.create(file.path(figures_dir, fig_folder))
plot_title = "min(negLL) + 0.5"

for (i in 1:nrow(participants_df)) {
  i = 3
  sub_i_name = participants_df$subjID[i]
  sub_i_name
  sub_i_csv = paste(sub_i_name, cvs_suff, sep = "")
  
  sub_i_fit_all = read.csv(paste(fits_dir, sub_i_csv, sep = "/"), header = T) %>% na.omit()
  sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit_all %>% 
    filter(exitflag == 1) %>% 
    # filter(negLL <= quantile(negLL, probs = 1000/nrow(.))) %>%
    filter(negLL <= (min(negLL)+0.5)) %>%
    select(negLL, prior_names, posterior_names)
  
  
  
  # generate 1000 samples from the remaining rows using bootstrapping
  random_2000 <- sample(1:nrow(sub_i_fit), size = 2000, replace = TRUE)
  sub_i_fit = sub_i_fit[random_2000,]
  
  # # calculate param means and medians
  # mean_alpha = mean(sub_i_fit$alpha_i)
  # median_alpha = mean(sub_i_fit$alpha_i)
  # 
  # mean_tau = mean(sub_i_fit$tau_i)
  # median_tau = mean(sub_i_fit$tau_i)
  # 
  # mean_epsilon = mean(sub_i_fit$epsilon_i)
  # median_epsilon = mean(sub_i_fit$epsilon_i)
  
  params_df = c("type", "mean", "median")
  # params_df = data.frame(type = c("alpha", "tau", "epsilon"),
  #                        mean = c(mean_alpha, mean_tau, mean_epsilon),
  #                        median = c(median_alpha, median_tau, median_epsilon))
  # 
  # bin_N = max(round(nrow(sub_i_fit)/bin_N0),5)
  bin_N = 30
  
  print(paste(i, sub_i_name, nrow(sub_i_fit), sep = "/"))
  print(sub_i_csv)
  
  posterior_fminsearch_histo_plot_fun(sub_i_name, sub_i_fit, params_df, cvs_suff, fig_folder, w_histo, h_histo, bin_N, figures_dir)
  
  corrMatrix_plot_fun(sub_i_name, sub_i_fit, plot_title, w_corr, h_corr, figures_dir, fig_folder)
}
```
